steps.en: Notices with contact details get an electronic reminder before the letter
steps.id: Notice yang punya kontak dikirimi pengingat elektronik sebelum surat
steps.why_en: The electronic reminder is switched off in every environment and frontend and backend notices are not told apart.
steps.why_id: Pengingat elektronik dimatikan di semua environment dan notice frontend dan backend tidak dibedakan.

steps.en: Owners who opted out of electronic reminders go straight to the letter
steps.id: Owner yang opt-out pengingat elektronik langsung ke surat

steps.en: System checks the notice was created by the backend system
steps.id: Sistem mengecek bahwa notice dibuat oleh sistem backend
steps.why_en: No check of where the notice came from exists; every notice follows the same path.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan asal notice; semua notice lewat jalur yang sama.

steps.en: Owner's latest address and contact details are refreshed before the first letter
steps.id: Alamat dan kontak terbaru owner diperbarui sebelum surat pertama
steps.why_en: Only owners with NRIC are refreshed; company and foreign owners are not refreshed automatically in production settings.
steps.why_id: Hanya owner ber-NRIC yang diperbarui; owner perusahaan dan asing tidak diperbarui otomatis di setelan produksi.

steps.en: Due, unsuspended notices at the first reminder stage are selected for the letter
steps.id: Notice jatuh tempo yang tidak disuspend di tahap pengingat pertama dipilih untuk surat
